description:
What you'll do

  • Test new features and verify bug fixes.
  • Perform functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and other QA documentation.
  • Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios before development is completed.
  • Test REST APIs using Swagger or Postman.
  • Verify data using SQL.
  • Reproduce reported issues and work with developers to investigate root causes.
  • Participate in refinement sessions, and release testing.
  • Help improve our testing processes and increase overall test coverage.

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years of experience in Manual QA.
  • Experience testing web applications.
  • Experience with Salesforce.
  • Good understanding of the software testing lifecycle.
  • Strong knowledge of test design techniques.
  • Experience creating test documentation from scratch.
  • Experience working with Jira and TestRail (or similar tools).
  • Familiarity with browser DevTools.
  • Experience testing REST APIs.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience with DB Testing (Postgres, MySQL).
  • Experience with CI/CD products.
  • Basic understanding of Git.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.
  • English level sufficient for daily communication.
  • Experience testing complex enterprise applications.

Nice to have

  • Basic knowledge of automation testing (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, etc.).
  • Linux experience.

Engagement Type

  • Contractor position.
